note: NOTE: category_id is nature, elemental, or spiritual. A monster drops that category's materials and essence. Combat stats (hp, attack, defense, xp, respawn_s, aggression) are v0 placeholders tuned so a level-appropriate player kills a regular mob in about 3-5 basic skill hits (e.g. Power Strike 140%), bosses take about 1-2 minutes, and a same-level mob deals about 5-10% of player HP per hit after player defense. See combat_formulas for the math and a worked example (level 5 Warrior vs Meadow Boar). aggression: passive = waits to be hit; aggressive = attacks on sight. respawn_s is seconds after a kill, per map timer. Night Stump is the cursed night variant of Old Stump. v0.1.2: hp halved across the board after playtest (regular mobs now die in ~3-4 hits at parity). attack_type: melee = damage only on body contact; ranged = slow, visible, dodgeable projectile (Crow only in Meadows). v0.1.3: attack_min/max are the per-hit roll (≈0.75–1.25× the typical attack column); no second variance dice on mobs. XP ×0.72 (−28%) across the roster. v0.1.3b: `anim_speed` is a per-monster multiplier on walk/idle/flap frame rate and walk wobble (1 = the v0.1.2 rate; Crow stays at 1 because that looked fine; other mobs are 0.5, i.e. 2× slower). Walk anim also scales with actual move speed. Attack wind-up timing is unchanged. v0.2.1: named quest variants Wool-Shoulder, Bank-Cracker, and Cinderback (respawn_s 0: they do not come back after a kill). anim_speed 0.5, attack_min/max dice. Spawn only while the matching quest step is active.  v0.2.7: Field Mouse 4 XP (was 7), Wool Sheep 8 XP (was 12).  v0.3.0: Whisperwood mobs Wisp, Thornling, Moss Lurker, Mire Toad and the Hollow Stag miniboss (level 10, 3 min respawn).  v0.3.1: Meadow Boar renamed Angry Bull (id angry_bull); new Boar (level 5, 140 HP, 27 attack, 8 def, 30 XP).

rows.name: Field Mouse
rows.description: A small mouse that scurries through the grass.

rows.name: Wool Sheep
rows.description: A calm sheep that grazes in the pasture.

rows.name: Crow
rows.description: A black crow that picks at the fields and fence posts.

rows.name: Burrow Mole
rows.description: A mole that digs under the meadow and turns up stones.

rows.name: Boar
rows.description: A bristly brown boar with small tusks. It lowers its head before a short charge.

rows.name: Angry Bull
rows.description: A heavy, dark-hided bull with a short temper. It paws the ground before it charges.

rows.name: Earth Sprite
rows.description: A small elemental made of magical earth energy, not ordinary stone.

rows.name: Ember Beetle
rows.description: A beetle that carries a little warmth in its shell.

rows.name: Frost Moth
rows.description: A pale moth that comes out in the cold morning dew.

rows.name: Spark Bug
rows.description: A bug that snaps with a little static when touched.

rows.name: Shrine Wisp
rows.description: A faint light that lingers by the meadow shrine.

rows.name: Dusk Wisp
rows.description: A dim wisp that drifts over the field at dusk.

rows.name: Old Stump
rows.description: An old tree stump in the grove. The Meadows boss. The only source of Heartwood.

rows.name: Night Stump
rows.description: The cursed night form of the Old Stump. Drops Cursed Dust once Heartwood is owned.

rows.name: Wool-Shoulder
rows.description: A stubborn sheep that plants its feet and hits back.

rows.name: Bank-Cracker
rows.description: A heavy mole that splits the dirt banks.

rows.name: Cinderback
rows.description: An ember beetle whose shell still glows.

rows.name: Wisp
rows.description: A soft drifting light. Passive until struck, then it keeps its distance and throws slow motes.

rows.name: Thornling
rows.description: A twiggy imp that hops in jittery bursts and throws thorns. Scratches when cornered.

rows.name: Moss Lurker
rows.description: A mound of moss on the canopy branches that is not moss. Wakes when you come close, then lunges.

rows.name: Mire Toad
rows.description: A big bog toad. Heavy hops, and a long tongue once its throat puffs.

rows.name: Hollow Stag
rows.description: The Keeper of the Whisperwood: a tall stag hollow through the ribs, lit by moss-light. Charges, sweeps, and stomps up roots.
